how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-elwynn-forest-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:114:details:0: Take this ⟦E3⟧ liquor to young Maybell. It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
rows.quest:114:progress:0: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? What did he say??
rows.quest:114:completion:0: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.
rows.quest:114:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦1⟧. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.
rows.quest:114:completion:2: And for you... please take this.
rows.quest:91751:title: Rough Wolf Pelts
rows.quest:91751:obj:0: Skin wolves around ⟦E5⟧ to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to ⟦E6⟧ near Goldshire.
rows.quest:91777:title: Rare Books
rows.quest:91777:obj:0: Recover "⟦E8⟧" and "⟦E9⟧" and return them to ⟦E10⟧ inside ⟦E11⟧'s Abbey.
rows.quest:99127:title: A Net Disaster
rows.quest:99127:obj:0: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
rows.quest:99128:title: Slimy Menace
rows.quest:99128:obj:0: Kill the murlocs at Crystal Lake.
rows.quest:99129:title: A Man About a ⟦E12⟧
rows.quest:99129:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E13⟧ about Jason's murloc problems.
rows.quest:99130:title: An Enticing Offer
rows.quest:99131:title: Baited for Success
rows.quest:99143:title: Bottles and Baubles
rows.quest:99143:obj:0: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby ⟦E12⟧ camp.
rows.quest:87:obj:0: Bring ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E17⟧ at the Stonefield Farm.
rows.quest:87:details:0: I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace. Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!
rows.quest:87:details:1: Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine. Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
rows.quest:87:progress:0: Hello, ⟦2⟧. Have you found my necklace?
rows.quest:87:completion:0: Oh, you found it! Thank you, thank you dear!
rows.quest:87:completion:1: Here, take this. It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
rows.quest:83:obj:0: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to ⟦E18⟧ at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
rows.quest:83:details:0: The Defias gang in ⟦E11⟧ wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear ⟦E19⟧ which I can use to make fine ⟦E19⟧ goods.
rows.quest:83:details:1: Bring me red ⟦E19⟧ bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.
rows.quest:83:details:2: Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
rows.quest:83:progress:0: I'm running low on ⟦E19⟧, ⟦3⟧. Do you have any for me?
rows.quest:83:completion:0: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...
rows.quest:88:obj:0: Kill ⟦E20⟧, grab her collar, then bring it back to ⟦E21⟧ at the Stonefield Farm.
rows.quest:88:details:0: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, ⟦E20⟧. The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!
rows.quest:88:details:1: So before she comes to our fields...⟦E20⟧ must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!
rows.quest:88:details:2: ⟦E20⟧ is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm. Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
rows.quest:88:progress:0: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?
rows.quest:88:completion:0: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:88:completion:1: Now, do either of these suit you?
rows.quest:5545:obj:0: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
rows.quest:5545:details:0: I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.
rows.quest:5545:details:1: I've already talked to ⟦E22⟧ about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
rows.quest:5545:progress:0: That deadline isn't getting any further away, ⟦5⟧. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
rows.quest:5545:completion:0: Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.
rows.quest:11:obj:0: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to ⟦E22⟧ at the Barracks.
rows.quest:11:details:0: Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of ⟦E5⟧. A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder. Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.
rows.quest:11:details:1: The ⟦E23⟧ Army will commend whomever helps kill them. Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
rows.quest:11:progress:0: Hail, ⟦6⟧. Have you been killing Gnolls...?
rows.quest:11:completion:0: I see you've been busy! You have our thanks, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:35:details:0: If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with ⟦E25⟧. He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.
rows.quest:35:completion:0: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
rows.quest:37:obj:0: ⟦E25⟧ wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.
rows.quest:37:details:0: A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned. To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.
rows.quest:37:details:1: ⟦E26⟧ north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
rows.quest:37:completion:0: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
rows.quest:39:details:0: Tell ⟦E24⟧ of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.
rows.quest:39:details:1: I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
rows.quest:39:completion:0: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.
rows.quest:39:completion:1: If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
rows.quest:40:obj:0: ⟦E13⟧ wants you to speak with ⟦E24⟧ in Goldshire.
rows.quest:40:details:0: ⟦8⟧, there's a new threat in ⟦E5⟧! Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!
rows.quest:40:details:1: I warned ⟦E24⟧, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits. He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.
rows.quest:40:details:2: Please, ⟦9⟧, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
rows.quest:40:completion:0: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.
rows.quest:40:completion:1: Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
rows.quest:45:obj:0: Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.
rows.quest:45:details:0: Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake. In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a ⟦E12⟧ village.
rows.quest:45:completion:0: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
rows.quest:46:obj:0: Bring 8 Torn ⟦E12⟧ Fins to ⟦E25⟧ at the east Elwynn bridge.
rows.quest:46:details:0: The ⟦E23⟧ Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn. Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the ⟦E23⟧ Army will reward you well.
rows.quest:46:details:1: The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
rows.quest:46:completion:0: You have the fins? Great! ⟦E24⟧ is anxious about the ⟦E12⟧ situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.
rows.quest:46:completion:1: Your actions have helped realize that.
rows.quest:52:obj:0: Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to ⟦E25⟧ at the east Elwynn bridge.
rows.quest:52:details:0: Hail, ⟦11⟧. Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!
rows.quest:52:details:1: We could use your help out here.
rows.quest:52:progress:0: Have you killed those wolves and bears?
rows.quest:52:completion:0: Thanks a lot for the help, ⟦12⟧. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.
rows.quest:52:completion:1: Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
rows.quest:59:details:0: For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor. I want you to take it to ⟦E18⟧ at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you. And after you receive it, ⟦13⟧, use it in the defense of Elwynn.
rows.quest:59:details:1: The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond ⟦E25⟧' post to the east.
rows.quest:59:progress:0: I have been commissioned by the ⟦E23⟧ Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.⟦14⟧⟦15⟧If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
rows.quest:59:completion:0: Ah, thank you for the marker. Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.
rows.quest:59:completion:1: Luck to you, brave ⟦16⟧. And may this armor serve you well.
rows.quest:71:obj:0: Deliver ⟦E30⟧ to ⟦E25⟧ at the eastern Elwynn bridge.
rows.quest:71:details:0: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to ⟦E25⟧ at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
rows.quest:71:progress:0: Hello, ⟦17⟧. Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
rows.quest:71:completion:0: You have confirmed my fears, ⟦18⟧. The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
rows.quest:76:obj:0: Explore the Jasperlode Mine, then report back to ⟦E24⟧ in Goldshire.
rows.quest:76:details:0: Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds. Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.
rows.quest:76:details:1: Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence. To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora. From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
rows.quest:76:progress:0: Hail, ⟦19⟧. What do you have to report? Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?
rows.quest:76:completion:0: Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say? Curses! The situation is worsening by the minute!
rows.quest:76:completion:1: Thank you for the report, ⟦20⟧. But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
rows.quest:109:obj:0: Talk to ⟦E31⟧. He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of ⟦E32⟧.
rows.quest:109:details:0: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, ⟦21⟧. If you haven't already, you should report to ⟦E31⟧. He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of ⟦E32⟧. I bet he could use your help. You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of ⟦E32⟧.
rows.quest:109:completion:0: Ah, so my friend sent you here? How kind.
rows.quest:109:completion:1: Well the ⟦E23⟧ Monarchy has abandoned our cause. Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption. If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
rows.quest:123:obj:0: Go to ⟦E24⟧ in Goldshire and give him ⟦E34⟧.
rows.quest:123:details:0: This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "⟦E35⟧" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:123:details:1: From the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.
rows.quest:123:details:2: This sounds important. You should report it to ⟦E24⟧ in Goldshire.
rows.quest:123:progress:0: What?!? We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!⟦22⟧⟦23⟧Let me see that note you have...
rows.quest:123:completion:0: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for. Thank you for the schedule. It will help us solve this mystery.
rows.quest:147:obj:0: Find and kill "the Collector" then return to ⟦E24⟧ with ⟦E36⟧.
rows.quest:147:details:0: If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom! Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me. It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...
rows.quest:147:details:1: That Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. You should search for him there.
rows.quest:147:progress:0: Did you find the Collector? Did you discover whom he's working for?
rows.quest:147:completion:0: You found him? Well done, ⟦24⟧. He won't be "collecting" from the Elwynn Mines again!
rows.quest:147:completion:1: And this ring you found is interesting... it's a membership ring for the old Stonemason's Guild in ⟦E23⟧. Why would a lowly thief have an artisan guild ring, and why are the Defias Thieves collecting money from our mines?
rows.quest:147:completion:2: Difficult questions. I hope one day we'll have answers.
rows.quest:239:obj:0: Go to the Westbrook ⟦E37⟧ and speak with ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:239:details:0: The ⟦E37⟧ on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity. They're requesting we send more ⟦E23⟧ soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!
rows.quest:239:details:1: If you can help, we could use it. Go and speak with ⟦E22⟧ at the Westbrook ⟦E37⟧ and see what he needs done.
rows.quest:239:details:2: The ⟦E37⟧ is down the road to the west. After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
rows.quest:239:completion:0: Marshall Dughan sent you, eh? Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!
rows.quest:239:completion:1: Our situation is, to say the least, a stressed one. I hope you can give us a hand.
rows.quest:91723:title: Delicate Instruments
rows.quest:91723:obj:0: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to ⟦E38⟧ in the Tower of Azora.
rows.quest:91725:title: ⟦E39⟧
rows.quest:91725:obj:0: Collect 5 ⟦E39⟧ from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to ⟦E40⟧ near the Tower of Azora.

quest:109.giver: Farmer Saldean («کشاورز سالدین»)، Farmer Furlbrow («کشاورز فرلبرو»)
